title: Извинения перед шейхом  (Apologies to the Sheikh)

segments.t: When the sheikh demands an explanation for the commotion in his suite, Max explains that the interpreter has been using His Highness's name to seduce the waitresses. The sheikh fires the interpreter on the spot.
Он использует ваше имя в своих целях.
Сказал, что если мы не извинимся, то нас уволят.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'What is happening here?' the guest raises the pitch on 'is happening' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Max answers right away.
'Excuse us, please.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'excuse me' before landing on 'please'.
'It is your interpreter's fault.' Max pairs 'interpreter / translator' with 'at fault, guilty' directly, since spoken Russian skips English filler words like 'the', 'a', and 'is'.
Он использует ваше имя в своих целях.
'He is using your name for his own purposes.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'he' and finishing on 'goal'. the guest answers right away.
'I beg your pardon, he will be fired.' The grammar packs 'ask for' and 'fired' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'What did he just say?' Senya raises the pitch on 'said' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question.
Сказал, что если мы не извинимся, то нас уволят.
'He said that if we do not apologize, we will be fired.' The meaning hinges on 'said' working together with 'will fire' in spoken Russian. Senya answers right away.
'Excuse us, please!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'excuse me' before landing on 'please'.
'Excuse us, guys, we are leaving already.' Notice how Russian expresses 'excuse me' and 'are leaving' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'This will never happen again!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'more' before landing on 'will repeat'. the guest answers right away.
'You may return to work.' the guest brings out the contrast between 'can' and 'to return' in a few short words.

'Let us get out of here to the kitchen quickly.' In Russian, the idea of 'to go' flows naturally into 'kitchen' without extra filler words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Он использует ваше имя в своих целях.
Сказал, что если мы не извинимся, то нас уволят.
With the interpreter exposed and the sheikh appeased, the staff hurry back downstairs to the restaurant. See you next time!
